phrases.phrase: Please check the names you entered. Each must belong to a forum user, and a question that asks for one forum user takes only one.
Fills the box when the form opens. Enter a username, or {username} for the filer's own name. A "Forum users" question can take several, separated by commas.
Shown in the box while it is empty, such as an example name. Leave blank if not used.
Takes the name of one forum user. The form refuses a name that belongs to no forum user.
Takes the names of several forum users, separated by commas. The form refuses any name that belongs to no forum user.
